- Fixed an issue with manually deleted messages that previously allowed them to reappear from local history caches or remain in the deleted-message archive
- Improved chat switching, which now keeps the input area steady and restores draft height without flickering
- Fixed an issue with jumping to the latest messages that previously caused an abrupt jump while chat history was still loading
- Fixed an issue with chat backgrounds that previously covered window materials or displayed an outdated size after resizing the window
- Fixed an issue with passcode-protected startup that previously left chat folders hidden after unlocking
- Fixed an issue with message links that previously reported missing messages before the requested messages had loaded
- Improved beta updates, which now use a dedicated update feed

---

- 修复了主动删除的消息仍从本地历史缓存恢复，或残留在已删除消息留档中的问题
- 改善了聊天切换效果，输入区保持稳定，恢复草稿时不再因高度变化而闪动
- 修复了聊天历史尚未加载完成时，跳转到最新消息会突然跳动的问题
- 修复了聊天背景遮住窗口材质，以及调整窗口大小后显示过期尺寸背景的问题
- 修复了设置本地密码后重启，解锁后聊天文件夹栏不显示的问题
- 修复了打开消息链接时，目标消息尚未加载便提示消息不存在的问题
- 改善了测试版更新，测试版现在使用独立的更新源
